title: Rich Sweetness Melon - 2x Mini Plug Plants
description:
Grow Your Own Deliciously Sweet and Aromatic Melons!


KEY FEATURES
• Exceptionally sweet and aromatic flesh
• Generous yields of medium-sized fruits
• Vigorous growth habit for easy cultivation
• Perfect for fresh eating and summer desserts
• Mini plug plants offer a quick and easy start


PLANT DETAILS
Type: Vegetables — Cucumis melo
Colour: Orange flesh, netted beige skin
Season: Summer to early Autumn (fruiting)
Growth Habit: Vining/Trailing
Flavour: Intensely sweet, juicy, and highly aromatic with a classic cantaloupe flavour
Time to Harvest: 80-90 days from planting


GROWING CONDITIONS
Sun: Full sun (at least 6-8 hours daily)
Soil: Well-drained, fertile, humus-rich soil
Watering: Consistent watering, especially during fruiting; avoid waterlogging
Spacing: 90-120 cm between plants
Height: 30-45 cm (vining spread)
Spread: 1-2 metres (vining)
Hardiness: UK H1b (protect from frost)


CARE INSTRUCTIONS
• Acclimatise plants gradually to outdoor conditions over 7-10 days before planting out.
• Plant in a warm, sunny, sheltered spot, ideally under cloches or in a greenhouse in cooler UK regions.
• Provide support for climbing vines if desired, or allow to trail along the ground on straw to prevent rot.
• Feed with a high-potash fertiliser once fruits begin to set to encourage good development.
• Harvest when the fruit skin changes colour and a slight crack appears around the stem, and the melon smells fragrant.


WHAT'S INCLUDED
2x Mini Plug Plants


DISPATCH
Plants are carefully packed and dispatched Monday-Wednesday to avoid weekend delays.
